manual.cultivar.blight.1.a: Each blight strain attacks certain species. An infected plant spreads it to nearby plants of its species: faster in wet soil and dense planting, and up to four times faster through genetically identical plants. Untreated, it kills the plant and depletes the soil.
manual.cultivar.blight.1.title: How blight spreads
manual.cultivar.blight.2.a: Blight resistance gives every infection attempt a chance to fail, and some alleles make a plant immune to particular strains. Mix genotypes, rotate species, raise Isolation Screens and space plantings out. A fuelled Burn Pan removes an infected plant safely and keeps a Blight Sample.
manual.cultivar.blight.2.tip: Analyse a Blight Sample in the Genome Lab: its strain report lists exactly which alleles defeat it.
manual.cultivar.blight.2.title: Defences
manual.cultivar.canopy.1.a: Jungles and forests hide Canopy Breaches: rings of eight portal frames. Canopy Resin turns up in Canopy Platform chests, jungle temples and woodland mansions. Craft a Canopy Key and use it on a complete ring to open the way.
manual.cultivar.canopy.1.title: Above the trees
manual.cultivar.canopy.2.a: Canopy plants carry wild alleles: superb blight resistance and tolerance, but dominant poor yield and growth. Cross wild into your line, then cross the offspring together: about 1 in 16 grandchildren keep the wild resistance with good yield. Wild resistance blends, so look for plants carrying two copies.
manual.cultivar.canopy.2.title: Wild blood
manual.cultivar.dg.f2: F1 x F1: 1 in 16 keeps both
manual.cultivar.fx.blight_resistance: chance to shrug off each infection
manual.cultivar.fx.nutrient_draw: how much soil each stage uses
manual.cultivar.fx.yield: how much produce a harvest gives
manual.cultivar.genes.1.a: Each allele has a value and a dominance rank. What the plant actually shows, its phenotype, comes from the pair.
manual.cultivar.genes.1.title: Eight genes
manual.cultivar.genes.2.a: The allele with the higher dominance rank is expressed and hides the other. Equal ranks blend, and the plant shows the average. Many of the best cultivated alleles are recessive, so a plant can carry them invisibly: only a Genome Lab reveals them.
manual.cultivar.genes.2.title: Dominance
manual.cultivar.genes.3.a: Wild alleles exist only in Canopy plants: tough and resistant, but poor yielders. Mutation-only alleles never occur naturally; they appear through spontaneous mutation or the Mutagen Chamber, and include some of the strongest alleles in the game.
manual.cultivar.genes.3.tip: On a Genome Card a green tag marks a wild allele and a violet tag a mutant one.
manual.cultivar.genes.3.title: Rare alleles

manual.cultivar.greenhouse.1.a: A Climate Controller measures the air space it sits in. Enclose it with Greenhouse Panes, glass, closed doors or solid blocks. If air escapes, or the space is too large, it reports a breach. Greenhouse Panes insulate best.
manual.cultivar.greenhouse.1.title: Sealing a greenhouse
manual.cultivar.greenhouse.2.a: Inside a sealed greenhouse the temperature drifts toward the controller's setpoint, Humidifiers and Dehumidifiers shift the humidity, and any Grow Light keeps light at 14. Crops that cannot grow outside can thrive in there all year.
manual.cultivar.greenhouse.2.title: Controlling climate
manual.cultivar.lab.1.a: Put a seed packet or Wild Seed and a sheet of paper into a Genome Lab. After a short analysis it prints a Genome Card with the full genotype, and you keep the sample.
manual.cultivar.lab.1.title: The Genome Lab
manual.cultivar.lab.2.a: Use a card to open its report. Genotype shows every allele pair and which allele is expressed. Profile charts the plant's strengths. Cross shows an exact Punnett square against the card in your other hand.
manual.cultivar.lab.2.tip: A line whose two alleles match at every gene is true-breeding: its seed grows into exact copies.
manual.cultivar.lab.2.title: Reading a Genome Card
manual.cultivar.lab.3.a: A Seed Bank stores named lines with their genome and pedigree; Seed Vault Drawers beside it add room, and each copy costs paper. The Field Notebook logs every cross you harvest, a Pedigree Sheet prints a line's ancestry, and Trial Markers number your test plots.
manual.cultivar.lab.3.title: Keeping records
manual.cultivar.market.1.a: Every harvest is graded C, B, A or Prime. The grade blends the plant's genes with how well it was grown: soil nutrients, pH, water, light and temperature, and any stress along the way. Good genes set the ceiling; good care reaches it.
manual.cultivar.market.1.tip: The Hand Lens shows the best grade a plant's genes allow. Higher grades are more filling, and Prime food also gives Regeneration.
manual.cultivar.market.1.title: Grades
manual.cultivar.market.2.a: Fill the Exchange's crate and it sells everything at dawn for emeralds. Prime pays four times Grade C. Selling a lot of one product lowers its price for a few days, so a varied farm earns more than a single crop.
manual.cultivar.market.2.title: The Produce Exchange
manual.cultivar.market.3.a: A Contract Board posts three orders a day: produce of a minimum grade, a line that expresses a trait, or a line carrying a named allele. Each fulfilled order pays emeralds and builds reputation. Every four contracts raise the board a tier, which unlocks bigger orders and the Supplies tab's rare items.
manual.cultivar.market.3.title: Contracts
manual.cultivar.mastery.1.a: Every allele you read on a Genome Card is recorded in your Allele Atlas, shown above. The atlas pays out at 12, 24 and 36 alleles and for the full set. Cells marked ? are mutation-only alleles: find them with the Mutagen Chamber.
manual.cultivar.mastery.1.title: The Allele Atlas
manual.cultivar.mastery.2.a: The Gene Editor rewrites one copy of one gene on a seed packet with an allele from your atlas, using one Edit Reagent. Build it from a Gene Editor Blueprint, sold by a tier 4 Contract Board.
manual.cultivar.mastery.2.title: The Gene Editor
manual.cultivar.mastery.3.a: The Show Bench judges a seed packet's genes out of 100, with a bonus for true-breeding lines. It certifies the packet and awards a bronze, silver or gold ribbon. Beat the world's best score for a species to set a record and earn emeralds.
manual.cultivar.mastery.3.title: The Show Bench
manual.cultivar.mutation.1.a: The Mutagen Chamber treats seed packets with a mutagen vial; the Thermal Shock Unit uses ice instead. Each seed is destroyed, gains one new random allele (possibly a mutation-only one), or comes out unchanged. Analyse the survivors to see what changed.
manual.cultivar.mutation.1.title: Inducing mutation
manual.cultivar.mutation.2.a: Use a Grafting Knife on a mature rootstock plant, then on an adjacent mature plant of the same species. The Graft Union shows the rootstock's hardiness with the scion's productivity, regrows after each harvest, and never sets seed.
manual.cultivar.mutation.2.title: Grafting
manual.cultivar.pollination.1.a: At stage 4 a plant flowers. Wind carries pollen between flowering plants of the same species a few blocks apart, favouring plants downwind. An Isolation Screen between two plants blocks their pollen completely.
manual.cultivar.pollination.1.b: A plant that is never pollinated sets seed identical to itself, apart from rare mutation.
manual.cultivar.pollination.1.title: Flowering and wind
manual.cultivar.pollination.2.a: Use a Pollination Brush on one flowering plant to collect pollen, then on another of the same species to cross them. An Isolation Bag stops a plant being pollinated at all. A fuelled Pollination Unit sends drones to make crosses for you.
manual.cultivar.pollination.2.title: Controlled crosses
manual.cultivar.pollination.3.a: Each parent passes one of its two alleles at random, gene by gene. Cross two plants that each carry one dominant and one recessive allele, and a quarter of the offspring show the recessive trait: the classic 3 to 1. A Genome Card's Cross tab works these odds out exactly.
manual.cultivar.pollination.3.title: Reading the odds
manual.cultivar.proc.1.a: The Processing Station presses, mills and cures produce into goods. The output keeps the input's grade, so Prime soybeans make Prime oil. Goods are worth more than the produce that went into them.
manual.cultivar.proc.1.title: The Processing Station
manual.cultivar.proc.2.a: Wheatline mills into Field Meal; maize or tuber into Starch, and Starch into Bioplastic. Soybeans press into Soy Oil, flax weaves into Linen Canvas, clover packs into Biofuel Cake, brassica pickles and gourd purees. Hold Shift over any good to see its recipe.
manual.cultivar.proc.2.tip: Use Soy Oil on any Cultivar machine to run it at double speed for a while.
manual.cultivar.proc.2.title: Goods
manual.cultivar.proc.3.a: Wrap 3 to 8 Cultivar foods in Linen Canvas to make a Ration Pack. Its strength rises with every extra crop species in it and with its lowest grade.
manual.cultivar.proc.3.b: A strong ration gives Regeneration, and the strongest add Resistance. A broad, well-grown farm feeds you best.
manual.cultivar.proc.3.title: Ration Packs
manual.cultivar.recipe_none: Not crafted: found in the world or made by a machine.
manual.cultivar.recipe_offline: Recipes appear when you are in a world.
manual.cultivar.soil.1.a: Managed Soil holds nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium from 0 to 100, plus a pH. Each growth stage uses nutrients, twice as much of the one the species prefers. Outside its pH band a crop slows down; far outside, it suffers.
manual.cultivar.soil.1.title: Nutrients and pH
manual.cultivar.soil.2.a: When any nutrient reaches zero the soil turns to Depleted Soil, and nothing grows until Compost restores it. Clover, soybean and tuber fix nitrogen as they grow, so rotating them with hungry crops keeps a field productive.
manual.cultivar.soil.2.title: Keeping soil alive
manual.cultivar.soil.3.a: The Compost Bin turns plant waste into Compost. Lime and Sulfur Hoppers nudge nearby soil pH up or down, the Nutrient Spreader feeds the neediest soil around it, and Irrigation Lines and Sprinklers keep the ground moist.
manual.cultivar.soil.3.title: Automating the field
manual.cultivar.start.1.a: Every Cultivar seed carries a genome: eight genes, each with two alleles. Together they decide how much a plant yields, how fast it grows, what cold and drought it survives, how much light it needs, how well it fights blight, how hungry it is, and how often its seed mutates.
manual.cultivar.start.1.b: Crossed plants pass their alleles on by real Mendelian rules. Your job is to breed cultivars that do exactly what you need.
manual.cultivar.start.1.title: Welcome, breeder
manual.cultivar.start.2.a: Craft a seed packet from a vanilla seed and paper, break grass for natural packets, or loot old trial fields and seed stores. A packet's genome is fixed the first time it is carried or planted.
manual.cultivar.start.2.b: Hoe farmland and use the packet on it. The farmland becomes Managed Soil, which tracks the nutrients and pH under that plant.
manual.cultivar.start.2.title: Getting seeds
manual.cultivar.start.3.a: The Hand Lens shows a crop's expressed traits, the Soil Probe reads soil, the Pollination Brush makes crosses and the Isolation Bag prevents them. Hold a Hand Lens or Soil Probe and look at a crop: a scanner panel reads it out beside the crosshair.
manual.cultivar.start.3.tip: Press the Field Manual key (J by default) at any time. After a hint, the manual opens at the chapter that explains it.
manual.cultivar.start.3.title: Tools of the trade

tooltip.cultivar.guide.dehumidifier: Lowers humidity inside a sealed greenhouse
tooltip.cultivar.guide.depleted_soil.1: Use Compost on it to restore it.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.edit_reagent: One edit's worth of Gene Editor reagent
tooltip.cultivar.guide.edit_reagent.1: Craft: Mutagen Vial, Canopy Resin, Bioplastic, Field Meal.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.edit_reagent.2: Also sold by a tier 3 Contract Board.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.field_manual.1: Press J any time to open it.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.field_manual.2: Chapters unlock as you discover things.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.field_notebook.1: Keep it in your inventory while harvesting.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.field_notebook.2: Every cross is logged with parents and results.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.gene_editor: Rewrites one allele on a seed packet
tooltip.cultivar.guide.gene_editor.1: Only alleles in your Allele Atlas can be written.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.gene_editor.2: Each edit uses one Edit Reagent.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.gene_editor_bluep: Plans for building a Gene Editor
Sold by a tier 4 Contract Board.
Craft it with a Genome Lab, a Mutagen Chamber and Bioplastic.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.genome_card.1: Made by a Genome Lab from a seed and paper.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.genome_card.2: Use it to read genes, alleles and plan crosses.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.genome_card.3: Reading a card records its alleles in your Atlas.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.genome_lab: Reads seeds and samples onto Genome Cards
tooltip.cultivar.guide.genome_lab.1: Needs paper. The sample is given back.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.gourd_puree.2: Keeps the grade of the gourd.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.grafting_knife.1: Clones a plant exactly, with no gene mixing.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.grafting_knife.2: Use on a mature rootstock, then a neighbouring scion.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.green_manure.2: Craft from 3 Clover Bundles and 1 Compost.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.greenhouse_pane: Glass pane that seals a greenhouse
tooltip.cultivar.guide.grow_light: Sets light to 14 inside a sealed greenhouse
tooltip.cultivar.guide.grow_light.1: Lets crops grow at night and indoors.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.hand_lens.1: Hold it and look at a crop to see its traits.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.hand_lens.2: Shows stage, vigor, blight and grade ceiling.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.harvest_collector: Sends a Harvester Cart over mature crops
The cart harvests, replants and unloads here.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.humidifier: Raises humidity inside a sealed greenhouse
tooltip.cultivar.guide.irrigation_line.1: It must be fed with water.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.isolation_bag.1: Use on a plant before it flowers.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.isolation_bag.2: A bagged plant can only pollinate itself.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.isolation_bag.3: Selfing for a few generations fixes a line.
Place it between plots to keep lines pure.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.lime_hopper: Slowly raises pH of soil within 2 blocks
tooltip.cultivar.guide.lime_hopper.1: Fill it with Lime Powder. Aims for pH 7.2.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.lime_powder.2: Load a Lime Hopper to dose soil automatically.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.managed_soil: Farmland that tracks N, P, K, pH and moisture
tooltip.cultivar.guide.managed_soil.1: Planting a seed packet on farmland makes it.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.managed_soil.2: Crops drain nutrients; top up with amendments.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.mutagen_chamber: Treats seed packets with a Mutagen Vial
tooltip.cultivar.guide.mutagen_chamber.1: Seeds may gain a new allele, including rare ones.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.mutagen_vial.1: Load into a Mutagen Chamber with seed packets.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.mutagen_vial.2: Each seed may gain a new allele or be destroyed.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.mutagen_vial.3: The chamber screen shows the exact odds.
Use it when a Soil Probe reads low K.
Use it when a Soil Probe reads low N.
Use it when a Soil Probe reads low P.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.nutrient_spreader: Feeds the neediest soil within 4 blocks
Use amendments on it to load it.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.pedigree_sheet.1: Hold a seed packet in your off hand, then use.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.pedigree_sheet.2: Prints four generations of its ancestry.
Keeps the grade of the brassica.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.pollination_brush: 1. Use on a flowering plant to take its pollen.
2. Use on another flowering plant of the same species.
That plant's seeds become a cross of both.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.pollination_unit: Sends Pollinator Drones to plants within 6 blocks
Runs on fuel or a redstone signal.
Set an exact cross with a Pollination Brush.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.processing_statio: The output keeps the input's grade.
Oil it with Soy Oil to double its speed.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.produce.1: Grade C, B, A or Prime depends on genes and care.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.produce.2: Sell it at a Produce Exchange or process it.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.produce_exchange: Sells its crate for emeralds every dawn
Higher grades pay more: Prime pays 4x.
Prices dip as you flood one product, then recover.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.ration_pack.1: Craft Linen Canvas with 3 to 8 Cultivar foods.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.ration_pack.2: More species and higher grades make it stronger.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.ribbon_bronze: Show Bench award: score 55 or more
tooltip.cultivar.guide.ribbon_gold: Show Bench award: score 85 or more
tooltip.cultivar.guide.ribbon_silver: Show Bench award: score 70 or more
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_bank: Stores seed lines as genomes, not items
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_bank.1: Withdraw a copy of a line any time for paper.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_bank.2: Seed Vault Drawers next to it add capacity.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_packet.1: Plant on farmland: it becomes Managed Soil.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_packet.2: Each packet carries a full genome.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_packet.3: Read it in a Genome Lab, cross it with a brush.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.seed_vault_drawer: Adds 8 lines to an adjacent Seed Bank
tooltip.cultivar.guide.show_bench: Judges a seed packet's genetics out of 100
tooltip.cultivar.guide.show_bench.1: Awards a ribbon and a certificate.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.show_bench.2: Beat a species record for bonus emeralds.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.soil_probe.1: Use on soil: shows N, P, K, pH and moisture.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.soil_probe.2: Sneak-use on the ground: a rover surveys 16 blocks.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.soy_oil.1: Use on any Cultivar machine: double speed for a while.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.starch.1: Processing Station: 2 Maize Cobs or 2 Tubers make 1.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.sulfur_hopper: Slowly lowers pH of soil within 2 blocks
tooltip.cultivar.guide.sulfur_hopper.1: Fill it with Sulfur Powder. Aims for pH 5.6.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.sulfur_powder.2: Load a Sulfur Hopper to dose soil automatically.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.thermal_shock_uni: Shocks seeds with ice to cause mutations
25% chance of a new allele, 8% of losing the seed.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.trial_marker: Labels a trial plot with a floating name
tooltip.cultivar.guide.trial_marker.1: Use a Trial Tag on it to label and number it.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.trial_tag.1: Rename it in an anvil to set the plot label.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.trial_tag.2: Use on a Trial Marker; each use numbers the next plot.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.wild_seed.1: A wild Canopy plant's seed with a wild genome.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.wild_seed.2: Analyse it in a Genome Lab or cross it with crops.
tooltip.cultivar.guide.wild_seed.3: Wild alleles often carry rare traits.
tooltip.cultivar.hand_lens: Reveals a planted crop's expressed traits
tooltip.cultivar.isolation_bag: Bag a plant to force self-pollination
tooltip.cultivar.knife_empty: Use on a mature rootstock plant, then on an adjacent scion of the same species
tooltip.cultivar.mutagen: Chemical mutagen for the Mutagen Chamber; treats 8 seed packets
tooltip.cultivar.notebook: Records every cross you harvest. Sneak-use to turn the page
tooltip.cultivar.pedigree_empty: Hold a seed packet in the off hand and use to print its ancestry
tooltip.cultivar.ration_empty: Craft from Linen Canvas and 3 to 8 Cultivar foods
tooltip.cultivar.shift: Hold Shift for how to use
tooltip.cultivar.soil_probe: Reads soil chemistry. Sneak-use on the ground to deploy a Soil Probe Rover
tooltip.cultivar.tuber_fixer: A leguminous groundnut-type tuber; fixes nitrogen
tooltip.cultivar.unset_genome: Natural seed: genome assigned when planted or carried
ui.cultivar.bench.record_help: Beat the world record for a species to earn bonus emeralds.
ui.cultivar.contracts.discard_help: Discard this order for 1 emerald. A new one arrives at dawn.
ui.cultivar.contracts.help_allele: Deliver one seed packet carrying this allele on either copy.
ui.cultivar.contracts.help_produce: Put the produce in the Deliver slot and press Deliver. Partial deliveries count.
ui.cultivar.contracts.help_trait: Deliver one seed packet whose expressed gene meets the target. Check it with a Genome Card first.
ui.cultivar.contracts.tier_help: Every 4 fulfilled contracts raise the board one tier: bigger orders, better rewards, more supplies.
ui.cultivar.copy_needs_paper: Needs %s paper in the paper slot
ui.cultivar.cross.hint: Hold another Genome Card of the same species in your other hand to cross against it.
ui.cultivar.cross.partner: Crossing with the card in your other hand: line #%s
ui.cultivar.cross.sibling: Crossing with an identical plant (cross-pollinated sibling)
ui.cultivar.editor.atlas_help: Alleles you have recorded. Rewards at 12, 24, 36 and the full set.
ui.cultivar.editor.locked_help: Read a Genome Card of a seed carrying this allele to record it in your Allele Atlas.
ui.cultivar.editor.switch_copy: Click to target this copy instead
ui.cultivar.exchange.demand: Demand %s%% (falls as you sell, recovers each day)
ui.cultivar.exchange.grades: C %s · B %s · A %s · Prime %s emeralds each
ui.cultivar.history.note: Sampled while this screen is open; the dashed line is the target.
ui.cultivar.hud.unsampled_hint: Use the Hand Lens on it to read its traits
ui.cultivar.legend.genotype: Glowing: expressed  |  dashed: hidden  |  blue: codominant  |  dots: dominance rank  |  green tag: wild, violet tag: mutant
ui.cultivar.outcome_note: One roll per seed: destroyed, else one new allele, else unchanged.
ui.cultivar.processing.help_1: Presses, mills and cures produce into goods.
ui.cultivar.processing.help_2: The output keeps the input's grade, so Prime in means Prime out.
ui.cultivar.processing.help_3: Goods sell for more than raw produce at the Produce Exchange.
ui.cultivar.processing.no_recipe: This item cannot be processed here
ui.cultivar.processing.oil_help: Use Soy Oil on any Cultivar machine to run it at double speed for a while.
ui.cultivar.self_clonal: Self-pollinated offspring are clones; cross to segregate.
ui.cultivar.stat.mutation_note: At least one of the 8 alleles it passes on
ui.cultivar.strain.note: Expressing any listed allele makes a plant immune. Genetically uniform plantings spread blight fastest.
